title: drynaria quercifolia
intro: Drynaria quercifolia, commonly known as Polypodium quercifolium, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat cancer, inflammation, and other diseases. The therapeutic actions of Drynaria quercifolia include anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and anti-oxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to possess anti-proliferative and pro-apoptotic effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
